messages:
Maya: Hi team — Nimbus EU (acct: nimbus-eu) reporting invoice blocked. Customer claims EU VAT ID valid and requests reverse-charge. Attached resale cert and PO in support ticket.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-550 flagged: VAT_CHECK_FAILED (VIES returned INVALID). Attempts: 1/3. Status: ON_HOLD.

Sree: Can you paste the VAT number + billed country? Sometimes formatting (spaces, prefixes) cause false INVALID from VIES.

Maya: VAT ID: FR987654321, billing country: France. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/tkt/4943. They also uploaded resale_cert_nimbus_nl.pdf and PO PO-5532.

Anna: I looked at the cert: it's for Nimbus Trading BV (NL). Billing address is France. That's an entity mismatch — resale cert is for the Netherlands company, but invoice must be to the French legal entity.

Liam: Finance note — for reverse-charge we need matching VAT registration for the invoiced legal entity or an explicit legal justification. Acceptable items: matching VAT reg document (FR) OR a signed letter tying the NL cert to the FR invoicing entity + legal rationale.

Maya: Customer replied in-ticket: "We recently reorganized; legal entity in NL handles procurement for the group. We can provide a group assignment letter signed by CFO. Can Redwood accept that for reverse-charge?" They uploaded group_letter_nimbus.pdf.

Sree: Repro of validator call I ran (local):
```
# VIES quick check
curl -s "https://vies.ec.europa.eu/validation?country=FR&vat=FR987654321" --max-time 6
# Response: HTTP 200 but payload: {"valid":false, "source":"VIES"}
# Our service maps false -> VAT_INVALID and halts after retry_count=1
```
Note: The VIES service sometimes returns false-negative for recently re-registered numbers. Also our retry/backoff is minimal.

Anna: I downloaded the group letter. It's signed, states NL company handles purchasing, and lists FR VAT number. Still gray area — prefer direct FR VAT reg doc but could accept group letter plus finance signoff.

Liam: I'll take compliance gating. Two options:
- Request FR VAT registration doc for the invoiced entity (preferred), OR
- Finance can provisionally apply reverse-charge if compliance signs off on the group letter and we attach CYA documentation.

Maya: Customer urgent: they need corrected invoice with PO applied by EOD for accounting close. Any fast path?

Liam: If compliance approves provisional path, we can reissue as RC_PROVISIONAL and add explicit note: "Reverse charge applied pending FR VAT reg verification." We'll also attach all uploaded docs and the PO. Payment terms remain unchanged.

compliance-bot: Compliance review requested for INV-2026-550: docs attached (resale_cert_nimbus_nl.pdf, group_letter_nimbus.pdf). Priority: high.

billing-bot: Audit: user Liam set invoice meta manual_reverse_charge_request=true at 1769994265.

Sree: Dev note: we should log VIES raw response body and response headers in the validator error message so support can see if VIES returned false vs timeout. Filing INF-2460 to add raw_response_id and retry metadata.

Liam: Compliance approved provisional reverse-charge given the signed group letter + PO, on the condition we obtain FR VAT doc within 10 business days. I updated invoice: INV-2026-550-RC-PROV and reissued PDF, attached PO PO-5532.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-550 status changed to ISSUED_RC_PENDING_VERIFICATION, tags: reverse_charge_provisional, audit_by=Liam.

Maya: Customer: "Got the revised invoice and PO applied — thanks. We'll upload FR VAT reg doc ASAP." :thumbsup:

Anna: I'll update ticket with next steps and deadline, and include checklist for finance follow-up.

Sree: Follow-ups: INF-2460 (VIES logging), KB-318 (support-runbook: manual RC provisional steps). I'll create the KB and link it to the ticket.

Liam: Flagging: if final FR VAT doc not received in 10 business days we need to revert the reverse-charge and issue corrected invoice. Marking this thread resolved for now. If payment fails or tax audit pops up, escalate to Legal. Thanks.
